name: Sage's Monograph
description: Possession of this text enables the acquisition of superior loot from elementals.

name: Hunter's Monograph
description: Possession of this text enables the acquisition of superior loot from beasts and avions.

name: Knight's Monograph
description: Possession of this text enables the acquisition of superior loot from giants and insects.

name: Dragoon's Monograph
description: Possession of this text enables the acquisition of superior loot from dragons and plants.

name: Mage's Monograph
description: Possession of this text enables the acquisition of superior loot from fiends.

name: Warmage's Monograph
description: Possession of this text enables the acquisition of superior loot from amorphs and undead.

name: Scholar's Monograph
description: Possession of this text enables the acquisition of superior loot from constructs.

name: Canopic Jar
description: A cursed jar said to hold the power to entrap a beast's soul, forever binding it as an arcana.

name: Writ of Transit
description: A writ given you by Tomaj granting its bearer right of passage through the east gate for the acquisition of foodstuffs.

name: Clan Primer
description: A reference containing clan exploits, hunt log, bestiary, and adventuring tips.

name: Galbana Lilies
description: Red flowers that grow only in Dalmasca. You found them after defeating the Rogue Tomato.

name: Cactus Flower
description: A rare flower that comes into bloom once every few years. Its petals have medicinal value, with those harvested from cacti turned cactoid said to be particularly potent.

name: Tube Fuse
description: A tube fuse pieced together from scavenged parts. It may not be much to look at, but it is well crafted.

name: Sword of the Order
description: A sword signifying a place among the Order of the Knights of Dalmasca. Dalan has tasked you with its delivery.

name: No. 1 Brig Key
description: This key opens the bulkhead of a brig aboard Leviathan.

name: Systems Access Key
description: This key grants access to Leviathan's security system, which controls the ship's internal alarm.

name: Dawn Shard
description: A piece of magicite left by King Raithwall. It signifies descent from the Dynast-King.

name: Shadestone
description: A dark, fist-sized stone. When exposed to the energies of the sun, it becomes a type of magicite known as sunstone.

name: Sunstone
description: A piece of magicite made from shadestone that has been imbued with the power of the sun. Sunstone is commonly used as a source of heat and light.

name: Feather of the Flock
description: A legendary cockatrice feather with a brilliant white sheen. Touching the feather, you feel a strange bond with the cockatrices...

name: Ring of the Toad
description: A jade ring bearing the likeness of a toad. The ring holds special meaning to the villagers who call Giza Plains their home.

name: Silent Urn
description: An urn given you by the villagers of Giza Plains. It is used to entrap the souls of beasts.

name: Site 3 Key
description: This key grants access to Site 3 of the Lhusu Mines.

name: Site 11 Key
description: This key grants access to Site 11 of the Lhusu Mines.

name: Crescent Stone
description: A stone cutting given you by Dalan. It is needed to reach the treasury in the Royal Palace. A lion is emblazoned on its face.

name: Medallion of Bravery
description: A medallion that opens a door within the Palace of Nabudis. Magick energies ebb and flow within.

name: Medallion of Might
description: A medallion that opens a door within the Palace of Nabudis. Magick energies ebb and flow within.

name: Medallion of Love
description: A medallion that opens a door within the Palace of Nabudis. Magick energies ebb and flow within.

name: Lusterless Medallion
description: A medallion that opens a door within the Palace of Nabudis. It is inert, its magicks long lost.

name: Stone of the Condemner
description: A piece of magicite said to open the way to a forbidden place. An inscription carved in the stone's back reads: "He with power, trust it not."

name: Errmonea Leaf
description: A medicinal herb found on Ozmone Plain. It has long been used in the treatment of fevers.

name: Rabbit's Tail
description: The tail of a vorpal bunny, a legendary black dreamhare found in Golmore Jungle. It is a prized reagent.

name: Ann's Letter
description: A letter written by Ann, chief steward aboard one of the East Ivalice Company's airships. It is addressed to her six sisters, each of whom works a different airship route.

name: Manufacted Nethicite
description: A special kind of magicite developed by the Archadian Empire. Unlike ordinary magicite, this absorbs magicks.

name: Rusted Scrap of Armor
description: A scrap of metal that looks as though it may once have been part of a piece of armor. You found it lodged between the claws of the Lindwyrm.

name: Sword of Kings
description: The sword left by King Raithwall. It is capable of destroying nethicite.

name: Treaty-Blade
description: The blade given Ashe by the Occuria. It has the power to cut new shards of nethicite.

name: Dusty Letter
description: A letter left in a deserted building in Lowtown. "East South- east East Southwest Southeast" is scrawled across the page.

name: Serpentwyne Must
description: A liquid base used in the fermentation of the finest serpentwyne. You obtained it after defeating the Marilith.

name: Dull Fragment
description: One of four pieces of a broken medallion. You obtained it beyond the sluice gates in the Garamsythe Waterway.

name: Blackened Fragment
description: One of four pieces of a broken medallion. You received it as a reward for finding and returning Samal's stolen articles.

name: Grimy Fragment
description: One of four pieces of a broken medallion. You obtained it with the help of Filo and Kytes.

name: Stolen Articles
description: A bundle of articles stolen by the contrite thief, only to be stolen once again by Orthros. Don't tease the...flan?

name: Barheim Key
description: An oddly shaped key received from the leader of a band of thieves. The key opens a door into the Barheim Passage.

name: Muramata
description: A fishing rod crafted by a master swordsmith. The rod is light, easily handled, and surpassingly strong.

name: Matamune
description: A cursed fishing rod that drinks the lifeblood of the fish it hooks. You obtained it from Gilgamesh, ancient man of mystery.

name: Cactoid Compact
description: A symbol of friendship conveyed upon trusted allies of the cactoids. They hold the bearers of such compacts in high honor.

name: Cactoid Commendation
description: A token given to cactoids who have distinguished themselves among the grove. The other races of Ivalice take little notice.

name: Merchant's Armband
description: An armband worn by the staff at Clio's Technicks in Bhujerba. The store's name is neatly embroidered on its surface.

name: Pilika's Diary
description: A diary kept by Pilika, a member of the staff at Clio's Technicks in Bhujerba. It chronicles her day-to-day affairs.

name: Ring of the Light
description: A ring worn by followers of the Light of Kiltia. The crest of Faram, the Father, is etched in its band.

name: Viera Rucksack
description: A bundle dropped by a viera traveler as she fled a vyraal. The cloth is dyed with an intricate pattern of trees.

name: Time-worn Necklace
description: A beautiful necklace in the Galtean style. You found it in Nalbina and took it as your own.

name: Lab Access Card
description: A Draklor Laboratory security card. It bears the seal of the Archadian Empire.

name: Moonsilver Medallion
description: A medallion made of moonsilver, a very rare metal. These medallions are traditionally given to loved ones as a token of affection.

name: Wanly Limned Message
description: The message contained in the blue bottle. Pallid letters shimmer on the page: "River...unde...o"

name: Green-hued Message
description: The message contained in the green bottle. Emerald letters shimmer on the page: "Forest...rgro...w"

name: Vermillion Message
description: The message contained in the red bottle. Vermillion letters shimmer on the page: "Fire...undb...h"

name: Auric Message
description: The message contained in the yellow bottle. Gilt letters shimmer on the page: "Ash...ridg...er"

name: Onyx Message
description: The message contained in the black bottle. Jet-black letters shimmer on the page: "Darkness...eton...e"

name: Goddess's Magicite
description: A piece of magicite you found in the treasury of the Royal Palace of Rabanastre. It must be extremely valuable.

name: Gift of the Great-chief
description: A gift prepared by the garif Great-chief in hopes of acquiring some Giza cockatrices. It is addressed to Brunoa, the nomad elder in the Giza Plains.

name: Broken Key
description: A broken, useless key. Sorbet had been meaning to get it fixed.

name: Sluice Gate Key
description: A key needed to operate the sluice gates. It used to be broken, but Sorbet had his brother repair it.

name: Wind Globe
description: A globe fashioned of silver rings decorated with arcane patterns.

name: Windvane
description: A device for reading the winds. It is used to navigate through sandstorms on the open desert.

name: Dragon Scale
description: A scale found on the corpse of a vyraal. Natural philosophers studying wyrms and their kin are known to pay well for such.

name: Ageworn Key
description: A key bartered in exchange for a dragon scale. It is said to open the way to the lair of a great wyrm.

name: Soul Ward Key
description: A key to a door in the Sochen Cave Palace. Dire beasts are imprisoned within.

name: Lente's Tear
description: A charm made by the viera. It grants passage through the barriers of Golmore Jungle.
